name: 140 judged-EV alignment parallel evaluation protocol
population: race_results present for every started horse
market_ev_predictions rows (model_version='mev-ens15-v1', result_pending_at_compute=true) for exactly the started horses

odds_observed_at is a single value within the race (a quote is one payload per race; a per-horse proxy time that differs across the field would split one race across h bands and normalise its winner NLL over a partial race) - otherwise excluded and counted (odds_observed_at_mixed_within_race)

fit_period_refused.rule: --from must be > 2026-10-04 (generator and c1 fit period)

odds_observed_at_provenance.quote: every market_ev_predictions row of the race carries the per-row token oddsobs=quote in logic_version (A3-era compute that read races.win_odds_observed_at)
odds_observed_at_provenance.proxy: any row carries oddsobs=proxy (fallback to race_horses.updated_at), no oddsobs token (pre-A3 compute) or NULL; a day containing any proxy race is dry_run=true and is not counted toward the judgement denominator
odds_observed_at_provenance.not_used: races.win_odds_observed_at at scoring time (overwritten by the final-odds write once results land, so it cannot say which source a compute used)

features: production as-of columns (horseracing_training.market_ev.load_rows -> build_features, history since 2007) with the 12 market columns recomputed from odds_used by r02_drift.market_block (popularity := odds_rank); weather/going are current DB values (D9)

arms.judged: mev-ens15-judged-v0, 15-seed average of 2026 boosters, log_min = log h; skipped (recorded) if the artifact is incomplete. A --judged-seeds partial average is a diagnostic arm: scored and recorded under the same name but never judged (verdict.diagnostic_arms_not_judged)
arms.c1: logit correction (4 coefficients, coefficients.json c1 = R02 real pairs) applied to ens15 p_hat_J
arms.c2: logit correction (4 coefficients, coefficients.json c2 = simulated 2025 OOF rows) applied to ens15 p_hat_J

metrics: EV_J bands <=1.0 / (1.0,1.2] / >1.2: n, won, sum p_hat, sum won / sum p_hat
EV_J>1.2: count and official-payout ROI (official_win_payouts; races without a payout excluded and counted) - recorded only
all of the above per h band and per day

paired_differences.bootstrap: race-day block bootstrap, B=4000, seed=20261011, the same draws for every arm and series; 95% percentile interval

judgement_rules.threshold: no verdict until >= 8 eligible (non-dry-run) race days AND >= 200 eligible races; below that verdict='recorded_only'
judgement_rules.i: judged arm only: closing-odds 2026 OOS (<= 2026-06-26) NLL <= ens15 + 0.0002 and race-normalised winner NLL not worse (checked separately, T012)
judgement_rules.ii: paired difference in nll_J vs ens15: 95% interval upper bound < 0
judgement_rules.iii: EV_J>1.0 band sum won / sum p_hat closer to 1 than ens15 (direction only while hits are few)

disclaimers: ROI の改善を示すものではない
判断時専用版(mev-ens15-judged)は表示・確定側に接続しない(研究 artifact・本番非結線)

revisions.note: initial freeze; provenance decided from races.win_odds_observed_at (defective: that column is overwritten by apply_final_odds after results). No eligible (non-dry-run) scoring was done under v0; the single v0 dry-run output was discarded.

provenance decided from the per-row oddsobs token; generator rho switched to the ICC estimator (the race-mean estimator is biased up by (1-rho)/n). Judgement rules, arms, metrics, bootstrap seed/B unchanged.

independent review (statistics-4, harness-leak-protocol-2): (a) population rule added - a race whose rows carry more than one odds_observed_at is excluded and counted (fail-closed; the 2026-10-05..10-12 pending runs all have exactly one value per race, so no scored race is affected); (b) a partial (--judged-seeds) judged average is recorded but excluded from the judgement checks. Judgement rules, metrics, bootstrap seed/B, fit-period refusal unchanged. The only v1 output (results/2026-10-10_2026-10-11.json) was a dry_run recording with no eligible day and is kept as recorded under v1's sha.
